decisions.reason: As a single design close to the core range, it is easier to prune after four years, but management would still tend to retain it unless its weak performance clearly outweighs the desire to justify the original launch.
This multi-model handle family still supports the firm's broad established assortment, so sunk investment and range-completeness make withdrawal less likely than for a single design.

Because this electronic access system was launched as a flagship for the firm's digital direction, its high development effort, public commitment and strategic importance make management especially reluctant to abandon it.
